entries.postTitle: How Overstimulation Affects Focus

captions.threads:
you ever read the same sentence four times and your brain's just like "nope, not doing this today"? that's your nervous system saying it's full. not lazy, not broken, just genuinely out of bandwidth.

what happens is you're already running ten tabs in the background. the notifications, the input, the decision-making, all of it stacks up until your focus just stops having any chairs left to sit in. your eyes scan the words but nothing lands because there's no processing power left to actually catch them.

the weird part is how quickly this happens once you know what to look for. you start noticing which environments wreck you vs which ones let you actually think. some people need silence. some need movement. some need to step outside for two minutes. but the common thread is you can't focus your way out of overstimulation. you have to discharge it first.

if this resonates: https://vibrationofawesome.com/blog/boom/posts/how-overstimulation-affects-focus
